# netcup_server_snapshots (Data Source)

The snapshots of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_snapshots" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) Snapshots of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `creation_time` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot.
- `disks` (List of String) Disks of the snapshot.
- `exported` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot is exported.
- `exported_size_in_kib` (Number) Size of the export in KiB.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether it is an online snapshot.
- `state` (String) State of the snapshot.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the snapshot.
